page.overview:
What is DUPLO Airport?

DUPLO Airport is a subtheme of the LEGO DUPLO theme, DUPLO Town.

The DUPLO Airport sets were first released in 1981. Two sets from 2009, 5592 My First Plane and 5595 Airport, had the LEGO Ville logo on their boxes and are listed on that theme page.
